name: buddy
description: A little Arduino desk buddy on a breadboard: an RGB mood light, a servo arm that can wave a paper flag and a piezo that chirps and plays little tunes, and a light sensor that notices when the room goes dark. It can't move around or see; it chirps, and the house speaker gives its words a voice.

light.about: your light sensor (a phototransistor): notices the room going dark
